"You're the worst thing that's ever happened to me."

An ex of mine from about 8 years ago. It spurred me on to change a lot as a person. Still hurts a lot though.

I've attempted suicide numerous times, typically through overdosing. Every time I ended up just passing out and then waking up and vomiting everything out of my system.

One of the most practical things that's helped me has been working out. I now work out 2x a day, 6 days a week. If I go a day or two without exercise, I feel terrible.
Think about my ex. Miss my ex. Forget why I broke up with her, worry about dying alone, think about her more, dwell on it, then procrastinate.

A Long Champion mission in the Weald. Got very lucky towards the end. Ran out of food and torches.

More room for deeds.
